name: guest_subst
description: Managed-code substitutions and feature switches for single-threaded, OS-less zkVM guests (ILC stage)
note: No native object: this module carries the ILC-stage inputs, for two reasons. The guest has one hart: substitutions is ILLink.Substitutions XML that stubs the thread-pool tuning and the processor queries; bflat applies it before the user's --substitution files and rejects duplicates, so users extend it and do not override it. The guest has no OS data: the features make globalization and timezones invariant, because a zkVM has no ICU data and no zoneinfo files, and a proof must not depend on them. Floating point is not a reason: soft-float arithmetic and the exact libm operations run.
